headline: Growth accelerates, profit dips on reinvestment
summary_short: Instacart (Maplebear) reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $1,043M, up 14.1% y/y, with GTV up 14% to $10.35B and orders up 9%, while GAAP net income of $111M fell 4% y/y as the company reinvested for growth.
summary_long: Revenue rose 14% y/y to $1,043M, driven by 14% GTV growth to $10.35B (advertising and other revenue up 16%, outpacing GTV) and 9% order growth. GAAP net income fell 4% y/y to $111M despite higher revenue, as R&D and G&A investment increased; Adjusted EBITDA still grew 19% to $313M. Operating cash flow rose 143% to $493M and free cash flow rose 156% to $480M. Instacart repurchased $324M of stock in the quarter and held roughly $1B in cash and similar assets at quarter end; shareholders' equity fell to $2,322M from $2,395M q/q. Q3 GTV guidance is $10.30-$10.55B (14% y/y growth) and Adjusted EBITDA $320-$340M (19% y/y growth), both on widened ranges reflecting increased scale.

drivers.explanation: GTV grew 14% y/y on more customers and enterprise engagement; advertising and other revenue grew 16%, outpacing GTV growth.
Net income fell y/y even as revenue grew, reflecting continued reinvestment across growth engines; Adjusted EBITDA (which excludes stock-based comp and other items) rose 19%.
Q3 GTV guidance of $10.30-$10.55B and Adjusted EBITDA guidance of $320-$340M were both widened to reflect increased operating scale, with midpoints implying 14% and 19% y/y growth respectively.
